sentences.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. I'm Zhan Haojing, a high school student.
sentences.cn: 晚上好，女士们先生们。我是詹昊晶，一名高中生。

detailed.explain: 晚上好。good 好的，evening 傍晚/晚上
女士们先生们。lady 女士，gentleman 先生，固定招呼用语
我是詹昊晶。I'm = I am 缩写
一名高中生。high school 高中，student 学生

sentences.en: I'm also a puppet performer.
sentences.cn: 我还是一名木偶表演者。

detailed.explain: 也，还。放在 be 动词 am 之后
一名木偶表演者。puppet 木偶，performer 表演者

sentences.en: Look at this puppet. If I move my fingers, it will come to life!
sentences.cn: 看看这个木偶。如果我动动手指，它就会活过来！

detailed.explain: 看。look at 固定搭配，后接宾语
这个木偶。this 指示代词
如果我动动手指。if 如果(条件状语从句)，finger 手指
它就会活过来。come to life 活过来，固定搭配

sentences.en: I was born into a family of Minnan puppet performers.
sentences.cn: 我出生在闽南的一个木偶戏表演世家。

detailed.explain: 我出生于(某家庭)。be born into 出生于

detailed.part: a family of Minnan puppet performers
detailed.explain: 闽南木偶表演世家。Minnan 闽南，puppet performer 木偶表演者

sentences.en: My grandpa and my mum are both among the best.
sentences.cn: 我的外公和我的母亲都是这行中的佼佼者。

detailed.explain: 我的外公和我的母亲。grandpa 外公，mum 妈妈(英式)
都是佼佼者。both 两者都，among the best 最优秀之列

sentences.en: When I was little, I loved the amazing stories they told with their hands.
sentences.cn: 小的时候，我喜欢他们用手讲述的精彩故事。

detailed.explain: 我小时候。when 当，little 小(年纪)
我喜欢那些精彩的故事。amazing 令人惊叹的
他们用手讲述的。tell stories with hands 用手讲故事

sentences.en: However, things changed when I became a teenager.
sentences.cn: 然而，当我成为一名青少年时，情况发生了变化。

detailed.explain: 然而。转折连词，比 but 更正式
情况变了。change 改变(过去式 changed)
当我成为青少年。teenager 青少年(13-19岁)

sentences.en: I felt less close to the art because people thought puppets were too old-fashioned.
sentences.cn: 我觉得与这门艺术不那么亲近了，因为人们认为木偶太老式了。

detailed.explain: 感觉不那么亲近了。feel 感觉(过去 felt)，less 更少地
这门艺术

detailed.part: because people thought puppets were too old-fashioned
detailed.explain: 因为人们认为木偶太老式了。old-fashioned 老式的

sentences.en: I didn't want to be part of puppetry unless I was asked to.
sentences.cn: 除非有人要求，否则我不想参与木偶表演。

detailed.part: didn't want to be part of
detailed.explain: 不想参与。be part of 成为的一部分
木偶表演艺术
除非有人要求。unless 除非(条件连词)

sentences.en: One day my mum showed me a performance by my grandpa's teacher.
sentences.cn: 一天，妈妈给我看了外公老师的一场表演。

detailed.explain: 有一天。讲故事常用开头
我妈妈给我看了。show sb. sth. 给某人看

detailed.part: a performance by my grandpa's teacher
detailed.explain: 外公老师的一场表演。by 由

sentences.en: The finely made puppets and their exciting movements brought back childhood memories.
sentences.cn: 精致的木偶和它们激动人心的动作带回了童年的记忆。

detailed.explain: 制作精良的木偶。finely 精细地
激动人心的动作。exciting 令人兴奋的，movement 动作
带回童年回忆。bring back 带回，memory 记忆

sentences.en: Then and there, my love for puppetry started to grow again.
sentences.cn: 就在那时，我对木偶表演的热爱重新燃起。

detailed.explain: 就在那时。固定短语
我对木偶表演的爱
重新燃起。start to do 开始，grow 增长

sentences.en: I posted my doubts about the future of puppetry online.
sentences.cn: 我在网上发布了关于木偶表演未来的困惑。

detailed.explain: 我发布了困惑。post 发帖，doubt 困惑
关于木偶表演的未来

sentences.en: To my surprise, the post was flooded with comments expressing warm feelings.
sentences.cn: 令我惊讶的是，帖子被表达温暖情感的评论淹没了。

detailed.explain: 令我惊讶的是。固定短语

detailed.part: the post was flooded with comments
detailed.explain: 帖子被评论淹没。be flooded with 被淹没
表达温暖的情感。express 表达，warm 温暖的

sentences.en: Many people showed their love for the art of puppetry and encouraged me to hold on.
sentences.cn: 许多人表达了对木偶表演艺术的热爱，并鼓励我坚持。

detailed.explain: 许多人表达了爱。show one's love 表达某人的爱
对木偶表演艺术
鼓励我坚持。encourage sb. to do 鼓励，hold on 坚持

sentences.en: A truth hit me - it was my duty to keep the art alive because puppetry was in my blood.
sentences.cn: 一个真相击中了我——让这门艺术保持活力是我的责任，因为木偶表演在我的血液里。

detailed.explain: 一个真相击中了我。hit 击中(过去式 hit)
这是我的责任。duty 责任
让艺术保持活力。keep alive 保持活力

detailed.part: because puppetry was in my blood
detailed.explain: 因为木偶在我血液里。be in one's blood 与生俱来

sentences.en: The art will be popular again if young people are interested in it.
sentences.cn: 如果年轻人对它感兴趣，这门艺术就会再次流行起来。

detailed.part: The art will be popular again
detailed.explain: 艺术会再次流行。popular 流行的

detailed.part: if young people are interested in it
detailed.explain: 如果年轻人感兴趣。be interested in 对感兴趣

sentences.en: So I held a puppet show at school.
sentences.cn: 于是我在学校举办了一场木偶表演。

detailed.part: So I held a puppet show
detailed.explain: 于是我举办了一场木偶表演。hold 举办(过去 held)
在学校

sentences.en: When I finished performing, I looked up and saw a surprising picture: the students were on the edge of their seats.
sentences.cn: 当我表演完，抬头看到一幅令人惊讶的画面：学生们都聚精会神地看着。

detailed.explain: 当我表演完。finish doing 做完某事
我抬头看。look up 抬头
看到惊人的画面。surprising 令人惊讶的

detailed.part: the students were on the edge of their seats
detailed.explain: 学生们聚精会神。on the edge of one's seat 全神贯注

sentences.en: Their eyes were glued to the puppets.
sentences.cn: 他们的眼睛紧盯着木偶。

detailed.part: Their eyes were glued to the puppets
detailed.explain: 眼睛紧盯着木偶。be glued to 紧盯着

sentences.en: After a warm cheer, they came to ask where they could see a full performance.
sentences.cn: 在热烈的欢呼之后，他们来询问在哪里能看到完整的表演。

detailed.explain: 热烈的欢呼后。cheer 欢呼声
他们来询问。come to do 来做

detailed.part: where they could see a full performance
detailed.explain: 哪里能看到完整表演。full 完整的

sentences.en: The positive reply from the young viewers gave me more courage.
sentences.cn: 年轻观众们的积极回应给了我更多勇气。

detailed.explain: 积极的回应。positive 积极的，reply 回应
来自年轻观众。viewer 观看者(复数 viewers)
给了我更多勇气。give 给(过去 gave)，courage 勇气

sentences.en: Since then, my puppet shows have drawn more attention both from home and abroad.
sentences.cn: 从此，我的木偶表演在国内外都引起了更多的关注。

detailed.explain: 从那时起。since 自以后

detailed.part: my puppet shows have drawn more attention
detailed.explain: 我的表演吸引了更多关注。draw attention 吸引注意(完成时 have drawn)
国内外。home 国内，abroad 国外

sentences.en: The old art is getting more interest and new stories.
sentences.cn: 这门古老的艺术正在获得更多的兴趣和新故事。

detailed.explain: 古老的艺术。old 古老的
正在获得更多关注。get interest 获得关注(现在进行时)

sentences.en: With more and more people joining in, I believe the special magic of this traditional art will last forever!
sentences.cn: 随着越来越多的人加入，我相信这门传统艺术的特殊魔力将永远持续下去！

detailed.part: With more and more people joining in
detailed.explain: 随着越来越多人加入。more and more 越来越多，独立主格结构
我相信。believe 相信

detailed.part: the special magic of this traditional art
detailed.explain: 这门传统艺术的特殊魔力。magic 魔力，traditional 传统的
将永远持续。last 持续，forever 永远
